Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), April volume, plate for the 2nd, filed by Commons under Category:People of Monastery of Stoudios. 2 April is Titus the Wonderworker, the monk of a Constantinopolitan house who was later made its shepherd - the folder's monk, confessor and wonderworker - and not the apostle Titus of 25 August, whose plate in the same series is numbered for that day.
